title: Ramsey number R(8,12), lower bound
statement: Find a two-colouring of the edges of K_n with no red K_8 and no blue K_12; it shows R(8,12) > n. The best known lower bound is R(8,12) >= 523, so a colouring of K_522 is known and one of K_523 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the n x n adjacency matrix of the red graph, one line of n characters 0/1 per vertex (1 red, 0 blue), symmetric with a zero diagonal; n <= 2048.

best_known.source: R(8,12) >= 523: Canli, github.com/arhancanli/quantavane-ramsey-records (K_522, found 6 Nov 2026); before it 519 (Canli, Zenodo 23920916); Small Ramsey Numbers rev. 18 printed blank; read 6 Nov 2026

provenance.keeper: Small Ramsey Numbers (S. Radziszowski), EJC Dynamic Survey DS1
provenance.revision: revision 18 (24 Apr 2026) and later sources named

score: n, the number of vertices of the colouring; it proves R(8,12) >= n + 1 (larger is better)
quantavane_note: our colouring is the best known (public in arhancanli/quantavane-ramsey-records)
